meta.name: web3-testing
meta.description: Test smart contracts comprehensively using Hardhat and Foundry with unit tests, integration tests, and mainnet forking. Use when testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

copy.tagline: 用主网分叉全面测试智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发布去中心化金融协议前需要全面检查合约行为
copy.tagline_en: Test smart contracts thoroughly with mainnet forking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build DeFi protocols and need automated contract tests before launch.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你的 Solidity 智能合约编写测试代码:用 Hardhat 或 Foundry 搭建测试套件,覆盖单元测试、集成测试、模糊测试、gas 消耗检查与主网分叉测试。
howto.when: 当你要求测试 Solidity 合约、搭建区块链测试套件或验证 DeFi 协议等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Solidity 合约写一套 Hardhat 单元测试
say.note: 会输出带 fixture 和断言用例的测试文件

say.text: 用 Foundry 给 transfer 函数写个模糊测试
say.note: 生成带 vm.assume 约束的 fuzz 测试

say.text: 把这个 Uniswap 主网地址 fork 到本地跑测试
say.note: 配置分叉并连接已有主网合约

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes test code for your Solidity contracts: it sets up test suites with Hardhat or Foundry covering unit tests, integration tests, fuzzing, gas usage checks, and mainnet fork tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to test Solidity contracts, set up blockchain test suites, or validate DeFi protocols, and similar cases.

say_en.text: Write a Hardhat unit test suite for this Solidity contract
say_en.note: Outputs a test file with fixtures and assertions

say_en.text: Write a Foundry fuzz test for the transfer function
say_en.note: Generates a fuzz test with vm.assume bounds

say_en.text: Fork this Uniswap mainnet address and run tests locally
say_en.note: Configures the fork and connects mainnet contracts
